start.title: Filhos de Adão
start.text:
Você abre os olhos como o primogênito de Adão e Eva.
Um segundo filho, Abel, nasce depois de você.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Live as the firstborn son of Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve gave birth to Cain, and then to his brother Abel.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Be born before Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Adam and Eve came first; Cain was their son.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Grow up as an only child
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain had a brother, Abel.

fields.title: Seu Trabalho
fields.text:
Os anos passam. Cada irmão encontra seu labor.
Qual é o seu?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Work the ground as a tiller of the soil
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Keep flocks of sheep like Abel
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Abel kept flocks; Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Refuse to work at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain worked the ground.

abel_pasture.title: O Trabalho de Seu Irmão
abel_pasture.text:
Você vê Abel do outro lado do campo.
O que ele está fazendo?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] See Abel keeping flocks of sheep
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:2 — Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] See Abel tilling the ground beside you
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Abel kept flocks, not that he tilled the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] See Abel fishing at the river
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis does not describe Abel fishing.

offerings.title: Diante do Altar
offerings.text:
Chega a hora de trazer uma oferta ao Senhor.
O que você trará?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Bring some of the fruits of the soil as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Bring a firstborn lamb from your flock
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Abel brought a lamb; Cain brought fruits of the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Bring nothing at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain did bring an offering, though not the best.

accepted.title: O Olhar do Senhor
accepted.text:
Você espera enquanto o Senhor olha para as duas ofertas.
O que acontece?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] The Lord looks with favor on Abel and his offering, but not on yours
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:4-5 — The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] The Lord favors both offerings equally
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the Lord favored Abel's offering, not both.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] The Lord accepts your offering and rejects Abel's
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the opposite — the Lord favored Abel's offering.

anger.title: Seu Rosto Cai
anger.text:
A oferta acabou. Algo surge em você.
Como você reage?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Become very angry, your face downcast
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:5 — Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Rejoice with Abel over his accepted offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain became angry, not that he rejoiced.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Bring a better offering the very next day
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis does not describe Cain bringing a second offering.

warning.title: O Pecado À Espreita
warning.text:
O Senhor fala com você.
O que Ele diz?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] 'Sin is crouching at your door — but you must rule over it'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:6-7 — The Lord warned Cain that sin was crouching at his door and he must rule over it.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] 'Bring a lamb instead of grain'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis does not record the Lord telling Cain to bring a lamb.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Nothing — the Lord is silent
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says the Lord did speak to Cain about sin at the door.

invitation.title: Você Fala Com Seu Irmão
invitation.text:
Abel se aproxima, confiante.
O que você diz?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Say to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:8 — Cain said to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field.'

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Invite Abel to worship at the altar together
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain led Abel out to the field, not to the altar.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Send Abel away and never speak to him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain called Abel to the field, not that he sent him away.

field.title: No Campo
field.text:
Tu e Abel estão a sós no campo aberto.
O que fazes?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Attack Abel your brother and kill him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:8 — Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Argue with Abel and then forgive him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain killed Abel; he did not forgive him.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Walk home without touching him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain killed Abel in the field.

confrontation.title: "Onde Está Teu Irmão?"
confrontation.text:
A voz do Senhor te encontra.
"Onde está teu irmão Abel?"

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Answer: 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Confess plainly: 'I have killed him'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain denied knowing; he did not confess plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Stay silent before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Genesis says Cain answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

wanderer.title: Um Errante Inquieto
wanderer.text:
O Senhor coloca uma marca em ti para tua proteção.
Vais vaguear a leste do Éden, na terra de Nod.
